name: native-ci-admission
goal: Expose admission timeouts so native CI can identify and resolve its blocking condition

evidence: Hosted native jobs time out without a waiting reason. A critical-pressure fixture reproduced a generic timeout while onWaiting reported the cause; hosted cause remains unknown.
test/services/resource-queue.test.ts covers pressure and cancellation but never expires that waiter or asserts its error. Extend its existing lifecycle to verify timeout detail and lease cleanup.
